cursor.build_gate: clean — 26 teeth green twice under python3, sealed through persist_validation under the network seal (seal=sealed)
cursor.exit_gate: REFUSED for want of a probe: no probes/ directory is declared, so WATCHME has nothing to enter with. The boat rests at PROVEME — built, proven, sealed, and not yet watched. Standing red, not a resting state (Law 4).
cursor.note: 26 teeth, every root injected, green on two consecutive runs, then sealed under the network seal (skills/idea/validations/test_idea_door.json). The tooth carrying the step's whole why is VERBATIM — capture is the one moment where translation loss is zero, and a door that tidied would pass every other check while defeating the step. The tooth that earned its keep on the first run is 'live trace untouched': it caught the proof's own CLI subprocess writing a send_back into the live trace, which would have made a fixture indistinguishable from a real refused capture in the very denominator bin/cmd/skilldial reads.
cursor.documented: RETROACTIVE. Journaled 2026-08-04 after the build, under Akien's ruling that same day: "you can document it and still capture the intention and why and so on, it's only forgery if it's not approved as documentation." That message is the approval. The `at` stamps are the true times, read from git (commit 5059794), not the clock at write time — a documented voyage that lies about when it happened is the forgery the ruling excludes.
